mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals labor market deterioration that precedes economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) indicate effective monetary stimulus boosting consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary stimulus with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 indicates robust manufacturing expansion supporting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during supply-side growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 0.1% MoM) signals healthy labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.1% MoM over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550.0 (thousands) indicate weakening housing demand, a leading indicator of economic slowdown that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 550.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during inflationary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 580.0 (thousands) and industrial production above 94 indicate synchronized demand-supply expansion, supporting economic growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting both HOUST > 580.0 and INDPRO > 94.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
